    n=len(grid); m=len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def connect(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    singles=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,6,1,8,3)]
    # Non-background isolated endpoint color; special rows contain length-three markers.
    endpoints=[(r,c,v) for r,c,v in singles]
    color=endpoints[0][2]
    points=[(r,c) for r,c,v in endpoints]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        vals=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg,)]
        if len(set(row))>1:
            nonbg=[(c,v) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
            if len(nonbg)==len(grid[0]):
                triple=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (row[0],)]
                if len(triple)==3:
                    points.append((r,triple[1]))
    points.sort()
    # Travel through ordered points, moving vertically then horizontally on each leg.
    for (r1,c1),(r2,c2) in zip(points,points[1:]):
        step=1 if r2>=r1 else -1
        for r in range(r1,r2,step): out[r][c1]=color
        stepc=1 if c2>=c1 else -1
        for c in range(c1,c2+stepc,stepc): out[r2][c]=color
    return out
